title: MEMBRANE: A Self-Evolving Contrastive Safety Memory for LLM Agent Defense
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and evaluation of a safety guardrail (MEMBRANE) for LLM agents to defend against adversarial jailbreak attacks. It evaluates performance using safety benchmarks like HarmBench and AgentHarm, but it does not study or benchmark religious beliefs, faith systems, or moral/ethical reasoning frameworks.
